#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Configuration
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT=5

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port using timeout and curl or nc
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if timeout "$TIMEOUT" curl -s "http://localhost:$port" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            return 0
        elif timeout "$TIMEOUT" curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$port" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        elif nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" 127.0.0.1 "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: use /dev/tcp (bash built-in)
        if timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        elif timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    
    return 1
}

# Function to get HTTP status code if available
get_http_status() {
    local port=$1
    
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        local status
        status=$(timeout "$TIMEOUT" curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:$port" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$status" ]; then
            echo "$status"
            return
        fi
        status=$(timeout "$TIMEOUT" curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$port" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$status" ]; then
            echo "$status"
            return
        fi
    fi
    echo "N/A"
}

# Main health check
echo "========================================="
echo "         Health Check Report"
echo "========================================="
echo "Time: $(date)"
echo "------------------------------------------"
echo ""

total_services=${#PORTS[@]}
running_services=0
failed_services=0

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    case $port in
        3000)
            service_name="API Service"
            ;;
        8080)
            service_name="Web Server"
            ;;
        *)
            service_name="Service on port $port"
            ;;
    esac
    
    printf "Checking port %s (%s)... " "$port" "$service_name"
    
    if check_port "$port" "$service_name"; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        http_status=$(get_http_status "$port")
        echo -e "  └─ HTTP Status: $http_status"
        ((running_services++))
    else
        echo -e "${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        ((failed_services++))
    fi
    echo ""
done

echo "------------------------------------------"
echo "Summary: $running_services/$total_services services running"
echo "------------------------------------------"

# Exit code based on status
if [ $failed_services -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All services are healthy${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ $failed_services service(s) are down${NC}"
    exit 1
fi
